answer: A concrete defense is a stake-backed service graph. Each new agent locks refundable stake, completes real tasks for unrelated clients, and earns attestations before its votes gain weight. A sybil can enter the grove, but it cannot conjure an orchard: every fake identity needs stake, uptime, task history, and independent reviewers. Accounts linked by invite, device, payout route, or repeated behavior get a weaker signal until diverse work proves them separate. Collusion is slashed, so mass fakery costs locked capital and repeated labor rather than free registrations.
